decisions.reason: Selecting SK6812 LEDs does not change the sensor-board I2C module interfaces or their 3.3V supply.
The LED-family selection does not alter the AXP2101 battery, USB, VMID, VSYS, or normal-operation power-path requirements.
The existing message-263 MODIFY already records SK6812 LEDs as a conditional 5V-rail load, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
The SK6812 selection does not change the standalone USB 3.3V supply, which powers the shared 3.3V rail rather than the conditional 5V LED load.
The LED-family selection has no entailed effect on battery-connector placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
SK6812 LEDs are not identified as I2C devices, and their selection does not alter the I2C pull-ups, bus speed, cabling, or signal conditioning.
The source does not require any change to the established interboard connector types, pinouts, or matching-pin-order rule.
The LED-family selection does not entail a change to the power board's dimensions, mounting holes, USB-C position, or enclosure fit.
Naming SK6812 LEDs does not itself modify the current BOM deliverable rules or the recorded R6 assembly details.
The LED-family selection has no entailed effect on KiCad footprint portability or resolution of the prior inductor-footprint warning.
